content: Generate official circular for Assignment Submission Deadline

**AI COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY**  
**OFFICE OF THE DEAN OF ACADEMIC AFFAIRS**  

**Circular Ref No:** AICET/ACAD/2023-24/CIR-042  
**Date:** October 24, 2023  

**Target Audience:** All Undergraduate & Postgraduate Students, Department Heads, and Faculty Members  

**Subject:** Strict Adherence to Assignment Submission Deadline for Ongoing Semester  

---

Dear Students,

This is an official notification regarding the submission of continuous assessment assignments for all ongoing courses in the current academic semester. 

To ensure systematic evaluation and timely publication of internal assessment marks, all students are hereby directed to strictly comply with the following instructions:

1. **Final Submission Deadline:** All individual and group course assignments must be submitted on or before **November 10, 2023, by 5:00 PM**.
2. **Submission Mode:** Submissions must be uploaded via the official Student Portal (LMS). Where physical submissions are required by course instructors, hard copies must be handed in at the respective department offices before the stated deadline.
3. **Late Submission Policy:** 
   - Submissions delayed by up to 24 hours will incur a **10% mark deduction**.
   - Submissions delayed between 24 to 48 hours will incur a **25% mark deduction**.
   - Assignments submitted **beyond 48 hours** from the deadline will not be evaluated and will be awarded zero marks.
4. **Academic Integrity:** All work submitted must be original. Plagiarism exceeding the acceptable limit (15%) will lead to rejection of the assignment and disciplinary action under academic guidelines.
5. **Technical Support:** Any issues with LMS access must be reported to the IT Support Desk (`support@aicet.edu`) at least 24 hours prior to the deadline. Last-minute technical claims will not be considered valid grounds for extension.

Students are advised to plan accordingly and complete their submissions well in advance to avoid last-minute rush or technical disruptions.

Warm regards,

**Dr. R. K. Sharma**  
Dean of Academic Affairs  
AI College of Engineering & Technology  

*Copy to:*
- Office of the Principal
- All Heads of Departments (HODs)
- Student LMS & Notice Boards
keyPoints: Submissions to be completed via LMS or respective Department Office
Strict late submission penalties apply (zero marks after 48 hours)
